name: Curios
description: Unusual objects with narrative, mysterious, personal, or situational interest

fields.description: A strange compass that quietly complains whenever it points north.
A candle whose small flame never consumes its wax.
A letter addressed to someone the character has never met.
A rare treatise discussing {{ rules.name }}, its possible uses, and the risks of misinterpretation.
A key with no known lock, marked by a symbol tied to an organization or building.
Pages whose meaning depends on a code, missing context, or absent person.
An incomplete route to {{ dungeon.name }}, marked with old landmarks, warnings, and doubtful promises of treasure.
A cloth figure bearing an erased name and traces of an old ritual.
A book protected by a lock or riddle whose contents cannot be read directly.
A toy or stuffed bear recognizable to a family, collector, or spirit.
A historical or scientific text with pages deliberately removed.
A fragile container whose contents produce an unusual sound or warmth.
An absurdly specific tool that cleans teeth perfectly and bites other dirt.
A living egg whose species, needs, and danger remain unknown.
A mineral or magical stone reacting to a place, person, or particular RULE.
An unusually calm chicken trained to follow its carrier and signal certain creatures.
A coin bearing an unfamiliar ruler, impossible date, or denomination nobody recognizes.
A pocket-sized mechanism that plays a delicate tune with one note conspicuously missing.
A tiny painted likeness whose subject seems almost familiar.
A complete deck with unfamiliar suits, peculiar court figures, and one card that resists shuffling.
A stone eye from an unknown creature, polished smooth without losing its unsettling detail.
A sealed bottle containing a tiny storm, snowfall, rainbow, or other weather that ignores the world outside.
A detailed street map of a settlement that no traveler, archive, or current chart acknowledges.
A cracked wand, orb, rod, or other focus that still reacts faintly to nearby magic.
